info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Piemonti Produce Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Piemonti Produce Catalog Management API facilitates the creation and management of detailed entries within the Piemonti produce catalog. This endpoint allows users to submit comprehensive details for new produce items to be included in the catalog. It is primarily utilized by catalog managers and inventory systems to ensure accurate and up-to-date product information. Typical use cases include adding new items, updating existing entries, and maintaining the overall integrity of the produce catalog.

post.summary: Create new details for Piemonti produce.
